messages:
Zoe (RM): kicking off tiny-batch canary (v2.3.1) to 5% on api-route in eu-west. change window 09:00-10:00 UTC. watch latency/5xx/embeddings. :eyes:
Ajay: smoke tests green. perf smoke looks ok on staging. dashboards: https://dash.redwood/inference/canary/1719234567
deploy-bot: deploy: v2.3.1 -> api-route started. target: 5% traffic. started_at=1719234600. status=rolling
Emily T: seeing p99 tail climb ~40ms over baseline at ~09:03. small uptick in kv-cache evictions (logs attached).
Olivia SRE: can we throttle concurrent requests per GPU to 2 while warmup? also suggest hold at 5% for 10m to watch error slope. :warning:
Mike R: +1 hold. errors on one host showing 1.2% 5xx (baseline 0.3%). not a huge spike but trending.
Zoe (RM): ok, hold at 5% and throttle. define rollback criteria: >1.5% 5xx sustained for 10m or p99 +100ms for 10m. anyone object?
Ajay: no objections. I'll pin route to v2.3.1 at 5% until we clear. command I'll run: ```bash
redwood route pin --route api-route --version v2.3.1 --percent 5
```
deploy-bot: routing: api-route pinned to v2.3.1 at 5% by Ajay at 1719234725. note=throttle=2
Emily T: adding a small prompt-set smoke now (embedding coherence + ranking) — will report in 5m.
Olivia SRE: I'll watch infra for OOMs and connection churn. setting alert: infra.kv.evictions > 20/min -> page oncall.
Mike R: logging shows one host had CPU jitter during the rollout. opening infra ticket: INF-3942.
Zoe (RM): thanks team. if errors hit rollback criteria we rollback to v2.2.9 and file incident. release notes link: https://release.redwood/v/2.3.1-notes. heads-up to support. :thumbsup:
Ajay: noted — if we need to back out: ```bash
redwood deploy rollback --route api-route --to-version v2.2.9 --reason "canary 5% regression"
```
deploy-bot: monitor: canary-5pct error_rate=1.1% p99_increase=38ms (update at 1719234867). status=held
Zoe (RM): we'll reconvene in 10m unless metrics worsen. posting to #release-updates after final decision.
